newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria April producer prices up 4.4 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria April producer prices up 4.4 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly producer price inflation was 4.4 percent in April after 36.7 percent the month before, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures show.
Year-on-year producer price inflation was 2,077.1 percent in April.
BULGARIAN PRODUCER PRICES APRIL MARCH APRIL'96

"Producer prices were rising more slowly last month mainly due to the stability of lev/dollar exchange rate, which prevented sharp rises of import prices," a NSI official, who declined to be named told Reuters.
Bulgaria's industrial output is strongly dependent on imports of energy resources and raw materials.
The Bulgarian lev traded stable between 1,500-1,600 per dollar in April after gaining to 1,600 from 1,800 the month before. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
